quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: U.S. FDA Grants Accelerated Approval to Bristol Myers (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The FDA granted accelerated approval to ZENBEXUS (iberdomide) with daratumumab and hyaluronidase-fihj and dexamethasone (ZDd) for adults with multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior line of therapy including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent; full approval is contingent on confirmatory trial(s). BMS says ZENBEXUS is the first FDA-approved CELMoD (cereblon-modulating protein degrader) and that this is the first approval in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma based on MRD-negative complete response. In EXCALIBER-RRMM (ZDd n=207 vs DVd n=213, median follow-up 16 months) MRD-negative CR was 41% versus 21% (p < 0.0001); 7.8% of patients discontinued ZDd for adverse reactions and fatal adverse reactions occurred in 10 patients (4.9%). ZENBEXUS had Breakthrough Therapy designation and was reviewed under Project Orbis; the label carries boxed warnings for embryo-fetal toxicity and venous and arterial thromboembolism.
